description: Dept. of Trade and Investment Policy - Order to impose a Special Commodity Levy on Mackerel and Potatoes for a period of 04 months commencing from 15.02.2015
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the imposition and amendment of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory changes to tax rates on specific commodities (mackerel fish and potatoes) and rescinds previous orders. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
